notes: Very common in Latin America; in Spain bonito is more usual.
Usually el mar; la mar is poetic or used by sailors.

sentences.text: Desde mi casa veo el mar.
sentences.translation: I can see the sea from my house.

sentences.text: El agua del mar está fría.

notes: sin duda = no doubt, definitely.

sentences.text: Hay muchos edificios nuevos en la ciudad.
sentences.translation: There are lots of new buildings in the city.

notes: a cargo de = in charge of; hacerse cargo = to take care of something.

sentences.text: Tiene un cargo importante en el gobierno.
sentences.translation: He has an important position in the government.

notes: Always feminine, even for a man.

sentences.text: La víctima era un hombre joven.
sentences.translation: The victim was a young man.

notes: luna de miel = honeymoon.

sentences.text: La luna está muy bonita esta noche.
sentences.translation: The moon is very pretty tonight.
Kids have a lot of energy.

notes: Also a noun: hace frío = it's cold (weather); tengo frío = I'm cold.

sentences.text: Hoy hace un día muy frío.
sentences.translation: It's a very cold day today.
Are you going to the dance?
She taught me two new dances.
We did lots of missions together.

notes: a la izquierda = on/to the left.

sentences.text: Es la segunda puerta a la izquierda.
sentences.translation: It's the second door on the left.

notes: In Latin America tomar is also very common for 'to drink'.

sentences.translation: Do you want something to drink?
He drank too much last night.
You're drinking a lot of coffee.

notes: Common in Latin America; volver means the same.

sentences.translation: I came back home very late.

gloss: to take out; to get out
notes: sacar una foto = to take a photo. saqué: c becomes qu before e.

sentences.translation: I took a photo of the sea.

sentences.text: En mi opinión, es un error.
sentences.translation: In my opinion, it's a mistake.
I don't care about your opinion.

notes: Also 'as soon as': apenas llegó = as soon as he arrived.
Also the adjective segundo, segunda = second (in order).

sentences.translation: I'll be back in ten seconds.

sentences.text: Fueron los segundos más largos de mi vida.
sentences.translation: Those were the longest seconds of my life.

sentences.text: Tomamos unas cervezas en el bar.
sentences.translation: We had a few beers at the bar.

sentences.text: Ella es la reina del baile.
sentences.translation: She's the queen of the dance.

sentences.text: El rey y la reina llegaron ayer.
sentences.translation: The king and queen arrived yesterday.
We have to leave early tomorrow.

notes: Masculine despite the -a: el tema.
Same as cárcel.

sentences.translation: He spent ten years in prison.
You're going to go to prison.

sentences.text: La prisión está lejos de la ciudad.
sentences.translation: The prison is far from the city.

notes: en público = in public. Also an adjective: un lugar público = a public place.

sentences.translation: Don't talk like that in public.

sentences.text: El público quiere saber la verdad.
sentences.translation: The public wants to know the truth.

notes: To save a life or a person; for saving money use ahorrar.

sentences.text: Tenemos que salvar a los niños.
sentences.translation: We have to save the children.
Did you see the game last night?

sentences.text: Veo todos los partidos con mi padre.
sentences.translation: I watch all the games with my dad.

sentences.text: Es del mismo partido que el presidente.
sentences.translation: He's from the same party as the president.

notes: a causa de = because of.

sentences.text: Llegamos tarde a causa del accidente.
sentences.translation: We arrived late because of the accident.

notes: For things and food; for the weather use hace calor.

sentences.translation: The sergeant wants to talk to you.

notes: la cena = dinner.

sentences.translation: Do you want to have dinner with me?
Last night we had dinner at a restaurant.
We're having dinner, I'll call you later.

notes: compañero de trabajo = coworker; compañero de cuarto = roommate. compañera = female.

sentences.text: Mi compañera de cuarto es muy amable.

sentences.translation: I have to go to the bank.

sentences.text: Nos sentamos en un banco del parque.
sentences.translation: We sat on a bench in the park.

sentences.text: Hace diez años, esta calle no existía.
sentences.translation: Ten years ago, this street didn't exist.
I live in a quiet area.

sentences.text: Hay zonas de la ciudad muy bonitas.
sentences.translation: There are some very pretty areas in the city.

sentences.text: La familia es la base de todo.
sentences.translation: Family is the basis of everything.

sentences.text: Tienen bases en todo el mundo.
sentences.translation: They have bases all over the world.

notes: soler + infinitive = to usually do; solía + infinitive = used to. suelo is also the noun 'floor'.

sentences.translation: What do you usually do on Sundays?

notes: el cliente, la cliente.

sentences.text: Siempre hay peleas en ese bar.
sentences.translation: There are always fights in that bar.
The wind comes from the north.

sentences.text: Está al norte de la ciudad.
Tengo que hablar con el coronel.
sentences.translation: I have to talk to the colonel.

notes: o becomes ue: apuesto. Te apuesto que… = I bet you…

sentences.translation: I bet you he won't come.
How much do you want to bet?

sentences.text: Estas calles son peligrosas de noche.
sentences.translation: These streets are dangerous at night.

notes: With an accent; te without an accent = you (pronoun).

sentences.text: Trabajo todos los días excepto los domingos.
sentences.translation: I work every day except Sundays.

sentences.text: Me gusta todo excepto el café.

notes: perder el juicio = to lose one's mind.

sentences.text: Tienes que decir la verdad en el juicio.
sentences.translation: You have to tell the truth at the trial.

notes: cerrar con llave = to lock.

sentences.text: Perdí la llave de la casa.

notes: estar equivocado = to be wrong (about something).
a mis espaldas = behind my back.

sentences.text: Pon las manos detrás de la espalda.
sentences.translation: Put your hands behind your back.

sentences.text: Hablan de mí a mis espaldas.
sentences.translation: They talk about me behind my back.

notes: False friend: exit = salida.

sentences.translation: I wish you lots of success.

notes: una especie de = a kind of.

sentences.text: Hay muchas especies de animales aquí.
sentences.translation: There are many species of animals here.
There are lots of differences between us.

notes: e becomes i: pido, pidió. To ask FOR something; preguntar = to ask a question.

sentences.translation: I'm only asking you for one thing.
What are you going to order?

notes: por ejemplo = for example.

sentences.text: Por ejemplo, mi padre nunca bebe café.
sentences.translation: For example, my father never drinks coffee.

notes: la radio = the radio; in much of Latin America el radio is also used for the device. el radio also means radius.

sentences.translation: I heard it on the radio.

notes: con calma = calmly, without hurrying.

sentences.text: Calma, todo va a estar bien.
sentences.translation: Calm down, everything's going to be fine.
I need a little peace and quiet.

notes: en el fondo = deep down; al fondo = at the back.

sentences.text: En el fondo es buena persona.
sentences.translation: Deep down, he's a good person.
The bathroom is at the back.

sentences.text: Está en el fondo del mar.
sentences.translation: It's at the bottom of the sea.

notes: un ser humano = a human being; los humanos = humans.
Estados Unidos = the United States.
Masculine despite the -a: el planeta.

sentences.translation: We live on a small planet.
Are there other planets like ours?

notes: Mostly in al respecto = about it, and con respecto a = regarding.

sentences.translation: What do you think about it?

sentences.text: No tengo nada que decir al respecto.
sentences.translation: I have nothing to say about it.

sentences.text: Tengo una pregunta con respecto al plan.
sentences.translation: I have a question regarding the plan.

notes: de regreso = back.

sentences.text: El viaje de regreso fue muy largo.
sentences.translation: The trip back was very long.
See you when I get back.

notes: debido a = because of, due to; con el debido respeto = with all due respect.

sentences.translation: Because of the accident, we arrived late.

sentences.text: Con el debido respeto, se equivoca.
sentences.translation: With all due respect, you're wrong.

sentences.text: No duermo bien debido al trabajo.
sentences.translation: I don't sleep well because of work.

notes: i becomes y: leyó, leyendo.

sentences.text: Lee la carta en voz alta.

notes: para = he/she stops, but usually the preposition 'for'. Similar: detener.
lleno de = full of.

sentences.text: Las calles están llenas de gente.
sentences.translation: The streets are full of people.

sentences.text: Un poco de respeto, por favor.

sentences.translation: I have a lot of respect for you.

sentences.text: Hay que tratar a todos con respeto.
sentences.translation: You have to treat everyone with respect.

notes: debajo de = under.
Irregular participle: escrito.

sentences.text: Lo llevaron a la estación de policía.
sentences.translation: They took him to the police station.

sentences.text: Hay cuatro estaciones en el año.
sentences.translation: There are four seasons in the year.

sentences.text: Todos a la pista de baile.
Quiere ser una estrella de cine.
sentences.translation: She wants to be a movie star.
There are lots of stars tonight.

notes: estar enfermo = to be sick; un enfermo = a sick person.
Works like gustar: me duele la cabeza = my head hurts.

sentences.text: Tu nivel de español es muy bueno.
sentences.translation: Your level of Spanish is very good.
We're moving on to the next level.

sentences.text: La salida del tren es a las ocho.

notes: confiar en alguien = to trust someone.

sentences.text: Tienes que confiar en tu equipo.
sentences.translation: You have to trust your team.

sentences.text: Mi color favorito es el azul.

sentences.translation: There are flowers of many colors.

notes: echar un vistazo = to take a look.

sentences.text: Le eché un vistazo al informe.
sentences.translation: I had a look at the report.

notes: Plural jueces. For a woman: la juez or la jueza.

sentences.text: Hay que hablar con el juez.
sentences.translation: We need to talk to the judge.

notes: el/la paciente. Also an adjective: sé paciente = be patient.

sentences.translation: The doctor has a lot of patients.

sentences.text: La paciente quiere ver a su familia.
sentences.translation: The patient wants to see her family.

sentences.text: Tengo las bolsas en el coche.
sentences.translation: I have the bags in the car.

notes: el arte in the singular, but las artes in the plural.
el baile = the dance.
¿Qué diablos…? = What the heck…? (mild).

sentences.text: Hizo un pacto con el diablo.
sentences.translation: He made a deal with the devil.
What the heck are you doing here?

sentences.text: Ese niño es un pequeño diablo.
sentences.translation: That kid is a little devil.
My family is from the south.

sentences.text: En el sur hace más calor.

notes: aprender a + infinitive = to learn to.

sentences.translation: I learned a lot from you.

sentences.text: Los precios aquí son muy altos.

notes: por completo = completely.
Shortened to San before most male saints' names. Also a noun: un santo = a saint.

sentences.text: Para ellos, esta es tierra santa.
sentences.translation: For them, this is holy ground.
